title.zh: 规定省、市、市镇民选职位定期选举的日期，以及接替1947年12月30日任期届满者的八名参议员选举日期的法案
title.en: An act to fix the date of the Regular Elections for Elective Provincial, City and Municipal Offices, and of the election of the Eight Senators who will succeed those whose term of office will expire on December Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Seven
title.orig: An act to fix the date of the Regular Elections for Elective Provincial, City and Municipal Offices, and of the election of the Eight Senators who will succeed those whose term of office will expire on December Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Seven

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_45_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: On the second Tuesday of November, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, and on the same day every four years thereafter, a regular election shall be held to elect the officials who will occupy all elective provincial, city or municipal offices throughout the Philippines. The officials elected shall assume office on the first day of January next following and shall hold such office for four years until their successors shall have been duly elected and qualified.

The election of the eight Senators who will succeed those whose term of office will expire on the thirtieth of December, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, shall also be held on the second Tuesday of November, nineteen hundred and forty-seven.
All laws or parts thereof inconsistent within the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: October 3, 1946
